Patch 0.32.0 (Audio foundation)

  • The first audio layer is live: A client-owned AudioManager now provides generated placeholder cues that can later be replaced with authored audio assets.
  • Moment-to-moment feedback now has sound: UI clicks and window open/close actions, loot pickup and inventory-full feedback, combat hits and misses, and jump takeoff and landing all route through the shared audio manager.
  • Audio controls are available in Settings: Players can toggle audio cues and adjust synthesized cue volume, with preferences persisted between sessions.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for audio defaults and cue definitions, loot success/failure cues, combat hit/miss cues, jump start/landing cues, settings presentation, and the 0.32.0 release state.

Patch 0.31.41 (Client UX closeout)

  • The final 0.31 UI pass closes the remaining overlay chrome gap: The death/respawn overlay now uses reusable CSS classes and shared button styling instead of inline layout and hover rules.
  • Death recovery presentation now follows the viewport-safe client baseline: Title, guidance, metadata, and respawn action sizing clamp for small screens while keeping the recovery copy readable.
  • The roadmap is ready for 0.32: 0.31 is marked closed for planned client-UX consistency work, making the next active slice the 0.32 audio foundation.
  • Regression coverage: Added closeout coverage for death overlay classes, removed inline death-screen chrome, 0.31.41 version presentation, and the 0.32-ready roadmap state.

Patch 0.31.40 (Viewport-safe window layout)

  • Window placement now runs through shared viewport rules: Primary menus, service windows, support modals, and the world map reflow through one managed layout path instead of each surface fighting for screen space.
  • Inventory companions now respect available width: Shop, Stash, and Forge keep Inventory beside them on wide screens, but narrow viewports prioritize the service window so full contents stay visible instead of overlapping.
  • HUD and tooltip surfaces are safer on small screens: Objectives gain a capped scroll lane, player HUD/mobile offsets avoid fixed offscreen positions, and tooltips clamp back into the viewport.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for managed menu exclusivity, wide-versus-narrow service companions, full-frame drag clamping, layout CSS guardrails, and 0.31.40 version presentation.

Patch 0.31.39 (Shared XP signature)

  • XP render throttling now reuses a UIManager serializer: The engine and UI layer share the same level, XP, and next-level XP signature whenever the UI serializer is available.
  • XP bar diffing now follows the same pattern as the HUD and hotbar: Progress-bar throttling and DOM updates compare the same displayed progression payload.
  • The 0.31 UI performance pass now has shared serializers across core HUD surfaces: Player stats, XP, hotbar cooldowns, and character sheet updates use UI-owned signature helpers.
  • Regression coverage: Added GameEngine render throttling coverage for the UIManager XP serializer path and direct UIManager XP serializer coverage.

Patch 0.31.38 (Shared player HUD signature)

  • Render throttling now reuses the UIManager player stat serializer: The engine and UI layer share the same HP, mana, ability, cooldown, cost, and class HUD signature whenever the UI serializer is available.
  • Player HUD diffing has one source of truth: Displayed stat rounding and ability payload comparisons stay aligned between render throttling and DOM updates.
  • The 0.31 UI performance pass keeps reducing duplicate signature logic: Future HUD display changes can update the UI serializer without repeating render-loop checks.
  • Regression coverage: Added GameEngine render throttling coverage for the UIManager player stats serializer path.

Patch 0.31.37 (Shared character sheet signature)

  • Render throttling now reuses the UIManager character sheet serializer: The engine and UI layer share the same visible character payload signature whenever the UI serializer is available.
  • Character sheet diffing has one source of truth: Stat, resource, point, equipment, rarity, potency, and socket comparisons stay aligned between render throttling and DOM updates.
  • The 0.31 UI performance pass reduces duplicated panel logic: Future character sheet display changes can update the UI serializer without repeating render-loop signature code.
  • Regression coverage: Added GameEngine render throttling coverage for the UIManager character sheet serializer path.

Patch 0.31.36 (Shared hotbar cooldown signature)

  • Render throttling now reuses the UIManager hotbar cooldown serializer: The engine and UI layer share the same displayed cooldown signature whenever the UI serializer is available.
  • Hotbar cooldown diffing has one source of truth: Slot count, empty-slot, skill, and rounded cooldown comparisons stay aligned between render throttling and DOM updates.
  • The 0.31 UI performance pass reduces drift risk: Future hotbar display changes can update the UI serializer without duplicating render-loop signature logic.
  • Regression coverage: Added GameEngine render throttling coverage for the UIManager hotbar cooldown serializer path.

Patch 0.31.35 (Transition UI cache reset)

  • Instance transitions now reset UIManager display caches: Scene swaps clear the UI layer's combat, portal hint, HUD, XP, hotbar, and character sheet diff signatures.
  • First-frame transition refreshes now reach both layers: The engine render signatures and UIManager display signatures reset together before the new scene presents.
  • The 0.31 diffing work now has a shared invalidation point: Performance guards remain local to each UI surface while transitions can force a clean visible refresh.
  • Regression coverage: Added GameEngine transition coverage for UI display cache resets and direct UIManager cache reset coverage.

Patch 0.31.34 (Character sheet reopen refresh)

  • Opening the character sheet now invalidates its diff cache: Each open cycle forces one fresh render before repeated visible updates are diffed again.
  • Reopened character panels cannot inherit stale DOM: Stats and equipment slots refresh after the panel is closed and opened, even when the player payload is unchanged.
  • The 0.31 panel diffing work stays safe across menu lifecycles: Performance guards remain active while open, but panel entry points rebuild their visible contents.
  • Regression coverage: Added UIManager coverage that reopening the character sheet refreshes visible stats and equipment slot updates.

Patch 0.31.33 (Hotbar cooldown refresh invalidation)

  • Hotbar slot assignment now invalidates cooldown diffing: Reassigning or rebuilding a skill slot forces the next cooldown overlay refresh even when the player cooldown value is unchanged.
  • Cooldown overlays recover after hotbar DOM changes: Newly recreated overlays no longer stay hidden behind a matching cached cooldown signature.
  • The 0.31 UI diffing pass stays resilient: The hotbar optimization now accounts for both state changes and local DOM replacement.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for recreated cooldown overlay DOM after assigning a skill to the same visible hotbar slot.
